newsitem.title: CHINA: China Lingnan to produce 130,000 T zinc,lead in 96.
newsitem.headline: China Lingnan to produce 130,000 T zinc,lead in 96.

text.p: China's Lingnan Lead and Zinc Group expects to produce about 130,000 tonnes of lead and zinc this year, a company official said on Tuesday.

The company based in the southern province of Guangdong expects to produce 150,000 tonnes of both lead and zinc next year and the total should rise to 185,000 tonnes in 1998, the official said in a telephone interview.
He said that a previously set output target of 200,000 tonnes for 1997 was too optimistic as there had been technical problems with one of the company's production lines.
The group was formed from the merger of Fankou Lead and Zinc Mine and the Shaoguan Smelter in July.
Combined output of lead and zinc by the two merged companies was 92,900 tonnes in the first nine months of the year.
Direct exports of the company reached 20,000 tonnes in the first nine months of the year, although additional exports were made through other companies, the official said.
